title: Mastery of Weaponry
summary: Defeat four opponents by adapting your weapons to their vulnerabilities.
overview: Defeat four opponents by adapting your weapons to their vulnerabilities.

phases.label: Weapon opponents
phases.description: Defeat the opponents in the randomized activation order, matching weapon types to each vulnerability.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Use slashing against the Hulking Bazu.
Use piercing, backstab or archery against Hemkai the Ascendant.
Use blunt or hand-to-hand attacks against the Granite Stoneguardian.
Steelshock strongly reduces most weapon damage; reserve spell damage for this opponent.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 1.
